title: Warmly Spiced Saudi Arabian Egg Noodles Dum
description: A mustardy and crunchy Saudi Arabian dish featuring egg noodles and dum, perfect for a post-workout meal, made in a raclette grill for a low-carb friendly option. This dish combines the flavors of Saudi Arabian spices with the comfort of egg noodles.
instructions: Preheat the raclette grill to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the egg noodles according to the package instructions and set aside.
In a bowl, mix together the dum mixture, mustard, ghee, cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cooked egg noodles to the bowl and mix well to combine.
Place the noodle mixture on the raclette grill and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir the noodles and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Remove the noodles from the grill and serve hot.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
